requirements.requirement: The public RDF possibility graph is canonical; Python models are lossless runtime projections.
Manufacture the bounded lawful possibility ecology before irreversible selection.
Only morphisms proven REVERSIBLE may enter canonical reversible closure.
Blocked, refused, stale and unsupported edges remain evidenced without invalidating siblings.
All combinatorial bounds and truncation are explicit evidence; silent pruning is forbidden.
Cheap topology extraction precedes semantic ranking and open-ended interpretation.
The empirical index cannot rank a combination absent from the current eligible set.
Selection exposes non-dominated alternatives and does not assume a universal best planner/provider.
Possibility graph, queries, planners and compiled routes cannot carry live execution authority.
Exploration never traverses DO; DO is an explicit irreversible frontier.
A content-bound graph/path/morphism cut must exist before canonical BRCE execution.
Consequential receipts bind graph, path, DO morphism, selection basis and parent receipt lineage.
Replay detects missing or changed graph/path/morphism/selection identities.
Cognition compiles into a re-admitted graph route, not cached authority or a privileged candidate.
Path identity, lawful endpoint composition and associativity are mechanically encoded.
ActionDefinition projects into the possibility graph and does not remain a competing canonical decision model.
REST, MCP and event transports expose powerless exploration and cut-bound canonical DO semantics.
DCM implementation cannot receive ALIVE until public graph admission, maximal closure, cut, real consequence, verification, cut-bound receipt and replay execute against an exact real subject.
